summary: Reproduced and identified root cause of disabled save button issue in Operations page. The save button is disabled because the accounting accounts dropdown shows 'لا توجد حسابات' (No accounts) due to a timing/race condition in the accountsQuery loading.

ui_bugs.issue: Accounts dropdown shows 'لا توجد حسابات' (No accounts) for several seconds after page load due to deferred loading. This causes submitDisabled to be true because form.accountingAccountId is empty.

integration_issues.issue: Save button is disabled until accounts are loaded (15-20 seconds delay). The accountsQuery has 'enabled: isDeferredDataEnabled' which delays loading until operationsQuery completes.

issues: No loading indicator shown while accounts are being fetched
User sees 'لا توجد حسابات' instead of a loading state

action_items: FIX: Remove 'enabled: isDeferredDataEnabled' from accountsQuery OR reduce the delay before isDeferredDataEnabled is set to true
FIX: Add a loading indicator to the accounts dropdown while data is being fetched
FIX: Consider pre-loading accounts data when user navigates to Operations page
critical_code_review_comments: accountsQuery at line 280 has 'enabled: isDeferredDataEnabled' which delays loading until operationsQuery completes
isDeferredDataEnabled is set to true only after operationsQuery.isSuccess OR after 900ms timeout (line 439-449)
This creates a cascading delay: operationsQuery (2-3s) + accountsQuery (2-3s) = 5-6s total delay
submitDisabled at line 1420 checks '!form.accountingAccountId' which is empty until accounts are loaded
The accounts DO load correctly after 15-20 seconds, but this is too slow for good UX

success_rate.frontend: 50% - Accounts load correctly but with significant delay

context_for_next_testing_agent: The save button disabled issue is caused by a timing/race condition in accountsQuery loading. The accounts DO load correctly after 15-20 seconds, but the user sees 'لا توجد حسابات' initially. Test credentials: username 'مدير' (no password).

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The accountsQuery has 'enabled: isDeferredDataEnabled' which delays loading until operationsQuery completes. This creates a cascading delay where accounts are not available when the user tries to create a new operation.
reproduction_steps: 3. Observe the accounting account dropdown shows 'لا توجد حسابات' (No accounts)
5. Observe the accounts are now loaded and the save button becomes enabled
mitigation_steps: Option 1: Remove 'enabled: isDeferredDataEnabled' from accountsQuery to load accounts immediately
Option 2: Reduce the 900ms timeout in the useEffect that sets isDeferredDataEnabled
Option 3: Add a loading indicator to the accounts dropdown while data is being fetched
Option 4: Pre-load accounts data in a parent component or route loader
